dct_description_sm: Geophysical surveys of pingos with diverse surface morphologies were conducted across the North American Arctic to better understand their internal cryostratigraphic architecture and the relationship between pingo form and hydrology. These data can be used to derive estimates of subsurface hydrologic pathways, permafrost structure, ground ice abundance, and stratigraphy at high spatial resolution along the provided transects.
dct_title_s: Ground Penetrating Radar, Geoelectrical, and Photogrammetric Surveys of Arctic Pingos near Prudhoe Bay, AK, USA and Tuktoyaktuk, NT, Canada, 2021-2024
